newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE wheat ends subdued day mixed.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE wheat ends subdued day mixed.

text.p: LIFFE wheat ended mixed after a subdued day's trading in which November occupied the most attention.
The market lacked fresh impetus either from currency, the usual source of news in recent days, or elsewhere, one trader complained.
"Nobody wants to pay up and sellers are few and far between," he said.
Futures reflected a quiet physical market, he said.
November last traded 0.05 stg higher at 83.05 stg. November volume was 112 lots of a lacklustre 177 total.
Barley futures moved lower, with November 0.50 stg lower at 78.75 stg on volume of just 20 out of a barley total of 24 lots.
Delivered market prices were little changed in slow trade, physical market brokers said.
